DecisionDebt connects company people, teams, projects, documents and decisions. It traces a proposed migration through FalkorDB, exposes ambiguous ownership and knowledge drift, and proposes source-backed remediation drafts for separate local approval.

Actual browser video captured natively at 3840×2160, 30 fps, edited with close-ups. Duration: 2:57.4. English AI narration by Deepgram (Aura 2 Thalia); English captions included. All Aster Works data is synthetic. Local approval and import/retraction use an isolated synthetic database. The public site is read-only. The LLM investigation shown is the previously recorded genuine provider run, not a new model call.
